I am a postdoctoral researcher at the School of Medical Sciences, Örebro University, and a licensed clinical psychologist. My work sits at the intersection of psychiatry, epidemiology and causal inference.

## Research interests

- Multimorbidity and psychiatric comorbidity in population registers
- Sleep, mental health and pain in children and adolescents
- Outcomes of electroconvulsive therapy in affective disorders
- Causal inference methods: target trial emulation, mediation analysis, marginal structural models
